name: National Science Foundation
program: DISES: Dynamics of Integrated Socio-Environmental Systems (NSF 23-609, concluded) and NSF human-environment successor programs

zero_reason.quote: Although there will be no funding for new DISES awards in Fiscal Year 2025, support for research on interactions between human and environmental systems will continue through other programs across the Foundation.

collect_note: The NSF funding announcements feed is read twice a day for a new DISES call or a successor human-environment systems solicitation (title words socio-environmental, DISES, sustainable regional systems, coupled natural and human, food-energy nexus). Nothing is open today because NSF concluded DISES after FY2024; the feed carries no deadlines, so a new call's date may need adding by hand.
